review.note:
Same-day follow-up to the reviewed 0.10.2 audit: dependency manifest and bounds unchanged; latest Python and Node candidates checked against the prior official release-note review and Python 3.14 eligibility. Windows npm launcher correction uses stdlib resolution and the standard npm Node entry points; 19 dependency-audit regressions passed, including actual offline Node execution with spaces, Unicode paths, literal semver metacharacters and configured prefix selection. Native Windows execution remains delegated to the existing platform workflow; no claim of local Windows validation.

Retained same-day upstream review:
Release 0.10.2 only splits an unchanged CLI help literal to satisfy consumer E501. Its parsed Python syntax tree is identical to 0.10.1, with no API, output, format, dependency declaration or Python requirement change. The following same-day direct dependency review remains applicable if the generator reports the same latest set.

Release 0.10.1 adds optional review schedule capacity estimation and permits explicitly requested aggregate review timeouts up to 14400 seconds. The default 900 seconds, source/coverage authority, complete-round review, owned cleanup, and terminal publication contracts are unchanged. No dependency declarations or Python requirement bounds change.

On 2026-10-30, reviewed current PyPI and npm metadata and official release notes. Reviewed latest set: hatchling 1.33.0, distlib 0.4.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.1, pytest 9.2.0, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, ruff 0.17.3, markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0. Every latest version is admitted by the existing lower-bound-only requirements; no latest stable version is excluded. All Python packages have non-yanked artifacts whose Requires-Python metadata admits 3.14. Distlib omits Requires-Python but explicitly classifies Python 3.14; pytest-xdist admits 3.14 through >=3.9 without a 3.14 classifier. This is eligibility evidence, not proof of runtime or native-platform compatibility. Mypy supplies macOS arm64 CPython 3.14 wheels. The npm engine requirement is Node >=22, satisfied by the established Node 24 toolchain.

Hatchling 1.33.0 adds official Python 3.15 support; the preceding 1.32.4 restores the build-hook generic interface. The backend and current build contract need no bound change. Source: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/.
Distlib 0.4.4 is unchanged from the human-reviewed 0.10.0 audit: launcher and executable-detection fixes and archive containment checks; Windows execution is separate evidence. Source: https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib.
Packaging 26.3 adds VersionRange and metadata 2.6 support and corrects requirement/marker normalization; Python >=3.9 includes 3.14. Existing PEP 440/508 parser use remains appropriate. Source: https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html.
Build 1.6.1 corrects a Windows symlink-probe regression. The 1.6.0 removal of BuildBackendException.exc_info and deprecation of project_wheel_metadata do not affect this project's build CLI use. Source: https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html.
Mypy 2.4 uses a native parser and supports Python 3.15; 2.4.1 corrects overload handling in two-phase checking and mypyc nested-function setup, and requires ast-serialize >=0.12.1. Reviewed the official tagged CHANGELOG and comparison because the default documentation heading still highlights 2.4.0. No new upper bound is justified; strict type checks remain necessary. Sources: https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html and https://github.com/python/mypy/compare/v2.4.0...v2.4.1.
Pytest 9.2.0 changes invalid configuration-path errors, makes optional parametrization arguments keyword-only, classifies plugin-import failures, and uses checked-hash assertion bytecode. Its fixture and CallSpec deprecations do not themselves justify excluding this release. The existing source-authoritative pytest loader and worker checks remain required; this audit does not claim those passed on 9.2.0. Source: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html.
Pytest-xdist 3.8.0 adds loadscope reordering controls. No worker-policy change or bound change is needed for this scheduling feature. Source: https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html.
Ruff 0.17.3 fixes incorrect UP032 f-string conversions and improves formatter output/lexing performance; its new shared-clock-mock rule is preview. Existing lint settings and py314 target are retained. Source: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.3.
Markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 updates dependencies including markdownlint, with Node >=22. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md.

Research does not upgrade installed dependencies or assert that latest versions passed gates. The current environment still has hatchling 1.32.4, distlib 0.4.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, ruff 0.17.1 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3. Test, full-gate and review evidence are recorded independently. The audit generator must query the same reviewed latest set before this release is accepted; any drift requires additional review.
